en: Translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, Imperial Censor of the Third Rank, Acting Assistant Director of the Court of State Ceremonial,
Great Master Mingjiao, the Subject Tian Xizai,
by Imperial Decree. Consecrated Mantra:

Oṃ namo bhagavatyai ārya-prajñāpāramitāyai tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya. Recite this mantra seven times, then perform the empowerment upon the crown of the head with the hands and touch the entire body. Thereafter, calming the mind, one should with a focused heart practice the visualization of the Bodhisattva Prajñāpāramitā, the Mother of Buddhas.

Visualize this Bodhisattva as having three faces and six eyes, with a body of true golden color, seated upon a lion throne of auspicious treasury (*śrīgarbha-siṃhāsana*), beneath which is a thousand-petaled golden lotus.
He has six arms; on the right side, the first arm holds a rosary, the second holds an arrow, and the third performs the gesture of granting boons (*varada-mudrā*).
The three arms on the left hold, first, a scripture; second, a bow; and third, a wish-fulfilling jewel (*cintāmaṇi*).
Thus, the six arms are adorned with various ornaments.
From his body, he further emits countless hundreds of thousands of nayutas of kotis of light rays, which fill all worlds.

He further visualizes all Tathāgatas and all Bodhisattvas, such as Tārā, endowed with the primary and secondary marks that adorn their bodies, and personally makes offerings to them with various incenses and flowers.
Having visualized in this manner, one further recollects the Heart Mantra:
Oṃ namo śākyamunaye tathāgatāya arhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | tadyathā | oṃ muni muni mahāmuniye svāhā | Then recite the Root Mantra: tadyathā...
Oṃ jaye jaye padme abhyāgaccha abhyāgaccha.
Sara saroni dīri dīri lā dīri dīra dīri nivata nuparāni mṛdutā tarani puraya puraya.
bhagavati sarvaśamama-maḥ
Paribhrāya saparivārāḥ sarvasattvānāṃ kṣama! Sarvakalpa!
Vāraṇe viśodhaya viśodhaya!
Having recited this mantra— *Buddhaḍiṣṭa-namaḥ svāhā*—
one should again perform the meditative visualization (*vipaśyanā*).

Visualize that to the right of the Mother of Buddhas, the Bodhisattva Prajñāpāramitā, are Śākyamuni Tathāgata, Dīpaṃkara Tathāgata, Amitāyus Tathāgata, Jñānaniścaya Tathāgata, Prabhāsarāja Tathāgata, Garjitasvararāja Tathāgata, Suvarṇapuṣpa Tathāgata, and Puṣpasaṃcayadhvaja Tathāgata.

To the left of the Bodhisattva were the World-Honored One Vipaśyin, the World-Honored One Krakucchanda, the World-Honored One Kanakamuni, the World-Honored One Kāśyapa, and the World-Honored One Ratnapāṇi.

In front of the Bodhisattva were the World-Honored One Mahāvairocana, the World-Honored One Ratnasaṃbhava, the World-Honored One Amitābha, the World-Honored One Amoghasiddhi, and the World-Honored One Akṣobhya.
Behind the Bodhisattva were the World-Honored Ones: Supreme Lotus, Supreme Jewel, Joy Auspiciousness, Lapis Lazuli Light, and Inconceivable Auspiciousness.
Before the Bodhisattva, there were also the noble Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva,
Maitreya Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, Mañjuśrī Bodhisattva, Namaskṛta Bodhisattva,
Acintyamañjuśabdābhigīta Bodhisattva, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva, Akṣayamati Bodhisattva, and Pratibhānakūṭa Bodhisattva.
the Bodhisattva Anantapratibhāna, the Bodhisattva Gaganagañja, the Bodhisattva Vimalakīrti, the Bodhisattva Vaśavartin,
the Bodhisattva Dharmodgata, the Bodhisattva Sadāprarudita, the Bodhisattva Candraprabha,
the Bodhisattva Dharmamegha, the Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha, the Bodhisattva Ratnagarbha, and the Bodhisattva Ratnaketu.
The Bodhisattva Śikhin, the Bodhisattva Gandhahastin, the Bodhisattva Kumbhīra,
and all such bodhisattva-mahāsattvas filled the buddha-field.
Furthermore, there are the Bhṛkuṭī Vidyārājñī and others, who also stand before the Bodhisattva.

Having visualized each member of this assembly of holy beings in this manner, one should further imagine exquisite incense, flowers, and precious ritual implements from both the human and celestial realms, using them to make offerings to the Mother Prajñāpāramitā, the Bodhisattva, along with all the attendant Bodhisattvas.
Having performed this visualization, this person shall before long achieve perfect enlightenment.
Thus spoke the Buddha in the *Buddhamātṛprajñāpāramitā-bhagavatī-bodhisattvā-dhyāna-sūtra*.
